query.statement: SELECT SALES_ORDER_ID, PLANT_ID, SALES_ORDER_NAME, CUSTOMER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PLAN_START_DATE, PLAN_END_DATE, PLAN_QTY, DELIVERED_QTY, DELIVERY_ORDER_ID, OWNER_ID, STATUS, IS_HOLD FROM SLS_SALES_ORDER WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) AND (@customerId IS NULL OR CUSTOMER_ID = @customerId) ORDER BY PLAN_START_DATE DESC

SELECT SALES_ORDER_ID, PLANT_ID, SALES_ORDER_NAME, CUSTOMER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PLAN_START_DATE, PLAN_END_DATE, PLAN_QTY, DELIVERED_QTY, DELIVERY_ORDER_ID, OWNER_ID, STATUS, IS_HOLD FROM SLS_SALES_ORDER WHERE SALES_ORDER_ID = @salesOrderId

SELECT SALES_REQUEST_ID, SALES_REQUEST_NAME, SALES_ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, REQUEST_DATE, REQUEST_QTY, STATUS FROM SLS_SALES_REQUEST WHERE (@salesRequestId IS NULL OR SALES_REQUEST_ID = @salesRequestId) AND (@salesOrderId IS NULL OR SALES_ORDER_ID = @salesOrderId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY REQUEST_DATE DESC
SELECT SALES_REQUEST_ID, SALES_REQUEST_NAME, SALES_ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, REQUEST_DATE, REQUEST_QTY, STATUS FROM SLS_SALES_REQUEST WHERE SALES_REQUEST_ID = @salesRequestId
